scope: The 21 targets in countries.json whose lat/lon are null. Each entry carries the sentence in the census record that documents its fit point.

coordinateBasis.recorded: The record carries the coordinates verbatim (MY-JAKIM WLY01).
coordinateBasis.documented-city: The record names the fitted place but does not carry its coordinates; the city-centre point is adopted, exactly as countries.json already does for the targets whose record names a city (TR-DIYANET-DOMESTIC Istanbul, KZ-MUFTIYAT Astana). These cells carry the flag in results.json.
coordinateBasis.brief-assigned: The shared brief assigns the point for this target by name and number.
